written: 2026-11-25 KST, committed before any timed run of this node
host_note: the host is shared with unpinned batch jobs of other projects (1-minute load 4 to 14 observed by the loop); wall time here is diagnostic unless the quality rule below makes a comparison decidable
threaded_arm_cores: taskset -c 6-11 (only for an arm that needs six cores; none in this part)
load_record: the 1-minute load average (/proc/loadavg, first field) is read and stored immediately before every timed process
counters: perf stat -x , -e instructions:u,cycles:u around one arm per process (perf_event_paranoid = 1); instructions:u and cycles:u are reported beside wall
quality_rule_verbatim: a wall comparison is decidable only if every process it uses started at load <= 3.0, or if the measured ratio clears the frozen threshold by a factor of 2 on the deciding side; otherwise it is NOT_DECIDABLE
quality_rule_application_in_this_part: V11 part a has no frozen wall threshold: every wall number of the smoke run is labelled smoke and diagnostic_only, and no wall comparison is judged. The rule is recorded here so that the later battery node inherits it unchanged.
smoke_labelling: every result row of the smoke run carries "label": "smoke"; no smoke row enters a battery table or a decision
threshold_policy: no frozen threshold is moved; thresholds of this node are those of PREDECLARED.json
